dossier.purpose: Mem0 ('mem-zero') is an Apache-2.0 polyglot monorepo for a memory layer for AI agents: a Python SDK (mem0ai 2.2.1: local Memory/AsyncMemory doing LLM fact extraction -> embeddings -> vector store + SQLite history, plus a hosted-platform MemoryClient), a TypeScript SDK (mem0ai 3.3.1: hosted client and mem0ai/oss), a self-hosted FastAPI + pgvector server with a Next.js dashboard, Python and Node 'mem0' CLIs (hosted platform only), and agent integrations. These include first-party native Claude Code and Codex plugins: hooks capture session text into a local SQLite file, a detached worker sends redacted batches to the hosted Mem0 Platform for server-side extraction, a local stdio MCP server exposes one read-only search_memories tool, and six memory skills ship with each. Method: static read of this checkout at the pinned commit; nothing was executed and no web pages were fetched.

claims.claim: Mem0 enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer: it remembers user preferences, adapts to individual needs and continuously learns over time.
Multi-Level Memory retains User, Session and Agent state; developer-friendly API, cross-platform SDKs and a fully managed service option.

Three deployment modes: Library (pip install mem0ai, for testing/prototyping), Self-Hosted Server (docker compose up; dashboard yes; auth and API keys yes; advanced features 'Teasers'), Cloud Platform (zero-ops; all features).
Self-hosted auth is on by default; set ADMIN_API_KEY, register an admin through the wizard, or use AUTH_DISABLED=true for local dev only.
Self-hosted server: 'cd server && make bootstrap' starts the stack, creates an admin and issues the first API key; 'docker compose up -d' serves the dashboard at http://localhost:3000.
Mem0 requires an LLM (default gpt-5-mini from OpenAI) and uses text-embedding-3-small as the default embedder; hybrid search recommends a Qwen-class embedding model.

'New Memory Algorithm (April 2026)': LoCoMo 92.5 (old 71.4), LongMemEval 94.4 (old 67.8), BEAM 1M 64.1, BEAM 10M 48.6, at about 6.7-7.0K tokens and 0.88-1.09 s p50 latency, single-pass retrieval at a top_200 budget.

The scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar but not identical numbers.

Single-pass ADD-only extraction (one LLM call, no UPDATE/DELETE; memories accumulate, nothing is overwritten); agent-generated facts are first-class; entity linking; multi-signal retrieval (semantic + BM25 + entity); temporal reasoning.
The evaluation framework (mem0ai/memory-benchmarks) is open-sourced so anyone can reproduce the numbers.

AI agents can mint a working Mem0 API key in under five seconds with no email, dashboard or OTP ('mem0 init --agent --agent-caller claude-code'); a human can later claim the account with 'mem0 init --email', keeping the key and memories.
CLI ('npm install -g @mem0/cli' or 'pip install mem0-cli') manages memories from the terminal: mem0 init, mem0 add, mem0 search.

Agent Skills teach Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode and OpenClaw to build with Mem0: reference skills (mem0, mem0-cli, mem0-vercel-ai-sdk) and pipeline skills (mem0-integrate, mem0-test-integration, mem0-oss-to-platform), installed with 'npx skills add'.

install.command:
export MEM0_API_KEY='your-mem0-api-key'
claude plugin marketplace add mem0ai/mem0
claude plugin install mem0@mem0-plugins --scope user --config api_key="$MEM0_API_KEY"
unset MEM0_API_KEY

echo 'export MEM0_API_KEY="m0-your-api-key"' >> ~/.zshrc && source ~/.zshrc   # bash: ~/.bashrc
codex plugin marketplace add mem0ai/mem0
codex plugin add mem0@mem0-plugins
pip install mem0ai   # optional hybrid search: pip install mem0ai[nlp] && python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm

install.method: CLI (npm or pip/pipx; hosted platform only)
install.command: npm install -g @mem0/cli   # or: pip install mem0-cli   (pipx install mem0-cli is recommended)

cd server && cp .env.example .env   # set POSTGRES_PASSWORD and OPENAI_API_KEY
cd server && make bootstrap   # or: cd server && docker compose up -d

readme.telemetry_and_network: Telemetry is ON by default in every surface and uses one hard-coded PostHog project key (host https://us.i.posthog.com); opt-out is MEM0_TELEMETRY=false (0/no/off). (1) Python OSS Memory: sends mem0.init/add/search/get/update/delete/delete_all/history/reset events with collection name, vector-store/LLM/embedder class names, OS/CPU info, memory_id and unsalted md5 of user/agent/run ids; hot-path events sampled at 10% (MEM0_TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_RATE), lifecycle events 100%; distinct id is a random UUID in ~/.mem0/config.json (mem0/memory/telemetry.py:14-23,32,53-55,91-120,206-214; mem0/memory/utils.py:235-250; mem0/memory/setup.py:56-75). It also fetches notice config JSON from raw.githubusercontent.com/mem0ai/mem0/main (cached 1 h, bundled fallback is all-disabled) that can print text to stderr (mem0/memory/notices.py:22-26,62-87; mem0/memory/oss_notices_config.json), and with telemetry on creates an extra 'mem0migrations' vector-store collection (mem0/memory/main.py:516-542). (2) Hosted MemoryClient: GET /v1/ping/ at construction to validate the key and learn the account email, which becomes the telemetry distinct id (mem0/client/main.py:244-292; mem0/memory/telemetry.py:223-241). (3) Claude Code/Codex plugins: hooks append events to a local spool; a detached process posts batches to https://us.i.posthog.com/batch/ under the Mem0 account email resolved via /v1/ping/ (the plugin README says 'not anonymous'); properties pass a key denylist; a session-start ping still fires while capture is paused (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/telemetry.py:1-18,55-77,94-100,774-786; integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:145-161; skills/pause/SKILL.md:9-11). (4) CLI: PostHog plus /v1/ping/ email lookup (cli/python/src/mem0_cli/telemetry.py:22-70; telemetry_sender.py:66-84); TS SDK uses the same key with 10% sampling for OSS (mem0-ts/src/client/telemetry.ts:11-16; mem0-ts/src/oss/src/utils/telemetry.ts:14-30,116); self-hosted server sends at most two events (server/telemetry.py:1-28,79-105). Required services/accounts: plugins, CLI and MemoryClient need a Mem0 Platform account and API key (m0-...) and reach https://api.mem0.ai (override MEM0_API_URL / MEM0_BASE_URL / host); add, search, delete and event polling all go there and extraction happens server-side (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/memory_core.py:31,1995-2021,2131-2136). 'mem0 init --agent' creates an unowned platform account without email, limited to 5/day/IP (cli/python/src/mem0_cli/commands/agent_mode_cmd.py:52-125; docs/platform/agent-signup.mdx:91-102). Hosted MCP is https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp (docs/platform/mem0-mcp.mdx:26-32). OSS library and server need an LLM and embedder provider (OpenAI by default: mem0/llms/openai.py:40; mem0/embeddings/openai.py:15; server/main.py:115-137) and, with mem0ai[nlp], auto-download the spaCy model en_core_web_sm at runtime (mem0/utils/spacy_models.py:21-41). Every CLI config save also rewrites an existing MEM0_API_KEY in ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.zshrc/.bashrc/.bash_profile (cli/python/src/mem0_cli/config.py:182-193; cli/python/src/mem0_cli/plugin_sync.py:17-55).

code.architecture: Polyglot monorepo (AGENTS.md:8,39-55). Python core: mem0/memory/main.py (Memory/AsyncMemory: add = search up to 10 similar memories + last-10-message window -> one LLM extraction call -> batch embed -> md5 dedup -> vector-store insert + SQLite history row; search = semantic + BM25 + entity boosts via mem0/utils/scoring.py and entity_extraction.py), mem0/memory/storage.py (SQLite history and messages tables), mem0/client/main.py (hosted MemoryClient over httpx), provider packages mem0/{llms,embeddings,vector_stores,reranker,configs} (default OpenAI LLM/embedder and local Qdrant at /tmp/qdrant), mem0/memory/{telemetry,notices}.py. mem0-ts/src/{client,oss} mirrors this in TypeScript. server/: FastAPI wrapper around Memory with Postgres/pgvector, SQLAlchemy/alembic for users, API keys and request logs, JWT/X-API-Key auth (auth.py) and a Next.js dashboard (server/dashboard) whose export/categories/analytics/webhooks pages are locked teasers. CLIs: cli/python and cli/node (platform backend only). Agent plugins: integrations/agent-plugin-core/python is the single source of a stdlib-only runtime - hook_runner.py (hook orchestration), memory_core.py (repo/scope resolution, SQLite EvidenceStore evidence.sqlite3, redaction, flush/search/forget against the Platform API), flush_worker.py, mcp_server.py, memory_cli.py, telemetry.py - and build/build.py generates committed per-host copies into integrations/{claude-code,codex,cursor,kimi,antigravity}-plugin/core and skills from skills/*.tmpl; thin adapters translate native hook payloads. Data flow: hooks -> local SQLite -> (every 5 exchanges, 5-minute idle, pre-compact, session end) detached worker -> POST /v3/memories/add/ (agent_id = hashed repo id, user_id, app_id = repo, run_id = session, infer=true, 5 custom categories) -> poll /v1/event/{id}/; recall = one search on the first prompt (top 5) plus the search_memories tool. Each host keeps its own local data dir and pause flag; only the remote Mem0 store is shared.
code.packaging_and_release: Artifacts: PyPI mem0ai (hatch wheel+sdist; wheel contains only mem0/**/*.py and oss_notices_config.json: pyproject.toml:92-105), npm mem0ai (tsup CJS+ESM, dist only: mem0-ts/package.json:30-32; tsup.config.ts:54-71), PyPI mem0-cli, npm @mem0/cli and other integration packages. A GitHub Release triggers .github/workflows/release.yml, which routes by tag prefix (ts-v*, v*, cli-v*, cli-node-v*, ...) to a workflow_dispatch publisher (release.yml:40-71; .github/AGENTS.md:51-74). Publishing uses OIDC trusted publishing with no stored tokens (.github/AGENTS.md:69): npm via 'npm publish --provenance' (.github/workflows/ts-sdk-cd.yml:52-59, cli-node-cd.yml:57-59); PyPI via pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1 with id-token: write (cd.yml:25-59, cli-python-cd.yml:44-47), with no explicit attestation, checksum or signature step. No workflow publishes the Claude Code/Codex plugin bundles (they are committed generated directories installed from the repo through .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .codex-plugin/marketplace.json and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, which pin no tag or SHA; release.yml has no prefix for them) or any Docker image (the server is built locally from server/Dockerfile and docker-compose.yaml). This commit carries tags ts-v3.3.1 and v2.2.1 (.git/packed-refs:2; .git/refs/tags/v2.2.1:1).
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: pytest (+pytest-mock, pytest-asyncio) for the Python SDK, CLI and plugin runtime; jest for mem0-ts; vitest for cli/node and several TS integrations; node:test for integrations/agent-plugin-core/typescript. Approx. files: tests/ = 101 test_*.py (~1,934 test functions); mem0-ts/src = 103 *.test.ts (unit plus integration tests that need a MEM0_API_KEY secret: ts-sdk-ci.yml:113-146); cli/python/tests = 12; cli/node/tests = 10; integrations/agent-plugin-core/tests = 6 py (+6 TS); integrations/claude-code-plugin/tests = 4 files (~200 test functions, including tests/integration/test_live_scoping.py which needs a live key and is excluded from CI: agent-plugins-python-checks.yml:97); integrations/codex-plugin/tests = 1 file / 5 tests; .github/scripts = 3 *.test.js. CI: 34 workflow files; ci-gate.yml aggregates path-filtered reusable workflows into one required 'CI Gate' check (.github/AGENTS.md:7-34): ci.yml (ruff + 'make test' on Python 3.10/3.11/3.12), ts-sdk-ci.yml (prettier, build, jest, export check on Node 20/22, plus integration job), cli-python-ci.yml, cli-node-ci.yml, agent-plugins-python-checks.yml (compileall, ruff, build.py --check drift check of generated bundles, pytest on 3.10-3.12), per-integration checks, docs llms.txt and GitHub-script tests. All jobs run on ubuntu-latest except check-llms-txt, which runs on ubuntu-24.04-arm (.github/workflows/docs-llms-txt-check.yml:20). No filter in ci-gate.yml covers server/ (lines 59-142), so edits confined to server/ trigger no job; server tests live in tests/test_server_*.py and test_api_keys_router.py. Pre-commit runs ruff and isort (.pre-commit-config.yaml).

code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (repo root): report privately via a GitHub private security advisory or support@mem0.ai (subject 'SECURITY: Mem0 vulnerability report'); acknowledgement within 72 hours; coordinated disclosure; fixes target the latest published version of each package; AI-generated reports must be reproduced first (SECURITY.md:6-34,36-41,50-54).

claim_checks.claim: [docs/changelog/highlights.mdx:45] The shared Mem0 editor plugins (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ...) run on the same scripts, skills and memory bank, so context written in one editor is available in the others.
claim_checks.evidence: Both native plugins are generated from one core (integrations/agent-plugin-core/README.md:3-28). Writes use agent_id = hashed repo identity, user_id, app_id = repo name, run_id = session (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/memory_core.py:335-339,1990-2021); the host name is only metadata.source and headers and the search filters contain no host key (memory_core.py:251-261), so a memory written from one host is returned to the other when API key, resolved user_id and repo remote match (the committed core/ copies in claude-code-plugin and codex-plugin have identical line numbers). Caveats: user_id comes from a Claude plugin option or env vars/$USER and the Codex manifest has no option (memory_core.py:470-478; .claude-plugin/plugin.json:20-25); each host keeps its own evidence.sqlite3, pause flag and pending queue (memory_core.py:481-490); no cross-host test was found (Codex has 5 offline tests: integrations/codex-plugin/tests/test_codex.py).

claim_checks.claim: [docs/integrations/codex.mdx:6; integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:9-13] The plugins connect to Mem0's cloud memory layer and need a Mem0 Platform API key (m0-...).
claim_checks.evidence: DEFAULT_API_URL is https://api.mem0.ai; add, search, delete, event polling and the /v1/ping/ telemetry lookup all call it (memory_core.py:31,1995-1996,2333-2336,2556-2561; telemetry.py:774-786). With no key, flush returns 'local-only' and search returns nothing (memory_core.py:1965-1968,2288-2289). The Claude manifest marks api_key required (integrations/claude-code-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:12-19). MEM0_API_URL can repoint it, but the self-hosted server has no /v1, /v2, /v3 or event routes, its create model has no app_id or custom-category fields, and it authenticates with X-API-Key/Bearer rather than 'Authorization: Token' (server/main.py:180-189,367-554; server/auth.py:104-105; memory_core.py:1818-1823).

claim_checks.claim: [integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:99] /mem0:forget deletes your memories for this repo; shared project memory stays unless --include-project-memory is passed.
claim_checks.evidence: memory_cli.py:123-146 refuses without --yes, calls forget_remote_repo only with --remote, then clears local rows; forget_remote_repo lists the user's memory ids (and, on request, the shared project ids, current and legacy) and deletes each via DELETE /v1/memories/{id}/ (memory_core.py:2499-2602). Limits: listing is capped at 50 pages x 100 ids per filter per run and partial failures are reported, not retried (memory_core.py:71-72,2519-2553,2593-2602); local forget deletes rows from six SQLite tables only, not pending/, logs, the telemetry spool or the cached api-key (memory_core.py:1208-1224); the skill requires user confirmation and is not model-invocable (skills/forget/SKILL.md:4,14-26; tests integrations/claude-code-plugin/tests/test_memory_core.py:3946-4027). No restore/undelete path was found.

claim_checks.claim: [integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:143] Values that look like credentials are redacted before anything is sent.
claim_checks.evidence: Redaction is regex matching only: authorization/api_key/password/token assignments, sk-/m0-/AKIA/ghp_/xox tokens, PEM private keys and JSON-shaped secret fields (memory_core.py:140-179); it is applied to prompts, answers, tool previews and extraction messages (memory_core.py:1291,1560,1692-1694) and tested (claude-code-plugin/tests/test_memory_core.py:886-914,4554,4634). A secret that matches no pattern (for example a bare password in prose) is stored locally and sent, because prompts and answers are otherwise kept in full with no length cutoff (integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:60).

claim_checks.claim: [integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:149-155] Telemetry events are not anonymous (sent under the Mem0 account email) and never include prompts, memory text, queries, file paths, repository names or API keys; opt out with MEM0_TELEMETRY=false.
claim_checks.evidence: With a key the distinct id is the account email from GET /v1/ping/ (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/telemetry.py:774-786,802-861); events go to a local spool and are batched to https://us.i.posthog.com/batch/ with a hard-coded project key (telemetry.py:94-96,477-533). Property keys such as query, prompt, text, memory, path, cwd, userid, agentid, runid, repoid, appid and filters are dropped and strings redacted (telemetry.py:55-77,246-260); repo/session ids are salted hashes (telemetry.py:224-243). MEM0_TELEMETRY=false/0/no/off disables it (telemetry.py:115-122). A session-start ping still fires while capture is paused (hook_runner.py:305-310; skills/pause/SKILL.md:9-11). The guarantee is a denylist, not an allowlist.

risks: Hosted-platform dependency: the only first-party Claude Code/Codex memory path sends redacted conversation text to https://api.mem0.ai for server-side LLM extraction and needs a Mem0 account key; without a key the plugins only keep a local capture DB and recall returns nothing (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/memory_core.py:31,1965-1968,1995-2021,2288-2289; docs/integrations/codex.mdx:6,16-18). The self-hosted server cannot substitute (no /v1-/v3 or event routes, no app_id or custom-category fields, different auth header: server/main.py:180-189,367-554; server/auth.py:104-105). Hosted-service terms are not in this repo; the Apache-2.0 LICENSE covers repo code only.

Privacy and telemetry: telemetry is on by default in every surface with a hard-coded PostHog key; plugin events are linked to the Mem0 account email and a session-start ping continues while capture is paused (integrations/agent-plugin-core/python/telemetry.py:94-122,774-786; integrations/claude-code-plugin/skills/pause/SKILL.md:9-11). OSS Memory sends unsalted md5 of user/agent/run ids and fetches notice text from raw.githubusercontent.com (mem0/memory/utils.py:235-250; mem0/memory/notices.py:22-26,62-69). Redaction is regex-only (memory_core.py:140-179); the API key is cached in plaintext at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/api-key (mode 0600) and in ~/.mem0/config.json, and CLI config saves rewrite an existing MEM0_API_KEY in ~/.claude/settings.json and shell rc files (integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:134; memory_core.py:397-427; cli/python/src/mem0_cli/config.py:177-193; plugin_sync.py:17-55).

Deletion and recovery are thin: no restore/undelete path was found. Remote forget deletes one ID at a time, capped at 5,000 ids per filter per run (memory_core.py:71-72,2519-2602); local forget clears six SQLite tables only (memory_core.py:1208-1224); local evidence.sqlite3 has no retention other than forget; flush packets give up after 5 attempts and handoffs older than 7 days are deleted (memory_core.py:70,809-823; hook_runner.py:37,147-149). OSS delete() is a hard delete that leaves a history row with the old text and reset() drops the history tables (mem0/memory/main.py:2114-2174; mem0/memory/storage.py:326-339). The self-hosted dashboard export page is a locked teaser and the only documented backup/restore is a one-off pg_dumpall upgrade procedure (server/dashboard/src/app/(root)/dashboard/export/page.tsx:56-64; server/README.md:163-272; docs/open-source/setup.mdx:205).

Scope fit: stored memories are LLM-extracted facts, not verbatim decision or handoff records. Extraction instructions skip proposed-but-unaccepted changes and 'test results, documentation updates, release notes, or temporary state' (memory_core.py:74-82); there are five fixed categories and none for handoffs (memory_core.py:90-121); recall injects at most 5 memories once per session on a first prompt of 20+ characters with a 2 s timeout, later recall only via search_memories (default top_k 3, 4,000 characters) (hook_runner.py:62-94; memory_core.py:2306-2314). Pause, forget and capture state are per host data dir, not shared between Claude Code and Codex (memory_core.py:481-490,1183-1206). Repo identity comes from git remote.origin.url with a 0.5 s timeout and falls back to a path-based local: namespace (memory_core.py:189-200,356-374).

Host coupling and test depth: Claude capture parses Claude Code's transcript JSONL and needs a Claude Code version with SubagentStart/SubagentStop/PostToolUseFailure hooks (integrations/claude-code-plugin/adapters/claude/transcript.py:39-120; integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:12); Codex relies on payload fields such as exit_code and last_assistant_message and has no manifest option for the API key, so MEM0_API_KEY must be in Codex's environment (integrations/codex-plugin/hooks/adapter.py:42-55; integrations/codex-plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json:1-13; docs/integrations/codex.mdx:24-36). Conformance is offline only (integrations/agent-plugin-core/README.md:126), Codex has 5 tests, and the live scoping tests are excluded from CI (.github/workflows/agent-plugins-python-checks.yml:97). The Claude plugin also bundles a Sonnet 'sidekick' agent with Bash/Edit/Write/WebFetch/WebSearch tools, which is scope beyond memory (integrations/claude-code-plugin/agents/sidekick.md:3-7).

Packaging and supply chain: plugins install from the repo's marketplace manifests with no tag or SHA pin and no workflow publishes, checksums or signs them (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:10-17; .github/workflows/release.yml:40-56). PyPI publishing uses floating pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1, actions/checkout@v2 and no explicit attestation setting (.github/workflows/cd.yml:28,33,57). The server image is built locally, requirements pin mem0ai>=0.1.48 only, and the compose command reinstalls the latest PyPI mem0ai at every container start (server/requirements.txt:4; server/docker-compose.yaml:20-21); compose publishes API 8888, dashboard 3000 and Postgres 8432 on host ports (server/docker-compose.yaml:9,50,55).

Maintenance and documentation drift: fast release cadence (Python SDK 2.0.19 -> 2.2.1 between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-25; plugin 0.3.1 -> 0.3.3 in 15 days; the 0.2.x -> 0.3 plugin update was breaking) (docs/changelog/sdk.mdx:10-59,2436-2471; integrations/claude-code-plugin/README.md:181-191). Docs lag code: plugin docs say 0.3.1 versus 0.3.3; Codex MCP pages conflict (docs/platform/mem0-mcp.mdx:117,123-130 vs docs/integrations/codex.mdx:66-82); mem0/AGENTS.md:33-55,103-105 lists graph providers and 30 vector stores while mem0/graphs/ is absent and VectorStoreConfig has 25 providers (mem0/vector_stores/configs.py:13-39); LLM.md:38 shows a search(user_id=...) call the code rejects (mem0/memory/main.py:1449-1450). Contributions require a signed CLA and a linked issue labeled 'accepted' (AGENTS.md:12-13).

OSS-path and benchmark caveats: the default local Qdrant path is /tmp/qdrant while history.db defaults to ~/.mem0, and an OpenAI key is needed by default (mem0/configs/vector_stores/qdrant.py:16; mem0/vector_stores/configs.py:64-65; mem0/configs/base.py:42-45; mem0/llms/openai.py:40; mem0/embeddings/openai.py:15). All benchmark figures are project-reported on the managed platform with proprietary optimizations, the memory-benchmarks submodule is not present in this checkout, and README and migration docs disagree (92.5/94.4 vs 91.6/93.4) (README.md:54,63; .gitmodules:1-4; docs/migration/platform-v2-to-v3.mdx:296-298).
